description: A Tributech Node deployment. Root of the unified namespace and identified by the public key of its node signer.

contents.name: Name
contents.description: Represents the name of the Tributech Node.

contents.name: PublicKey
contents.description: PEM-encoded public key of the node signer. Uniquely identifies this Tributech Node.
contents.comment: The node signer key pair is loaded once per deployment, so its public key is the only value that stays stable across restarts, renames and tenant changes.

contents.name: Thumbprint
contents.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of the node signer public key, for display and lookup.

contents.name: CypherSuite
contents.description: Cryptographic algorithm the node signer uses to sign data.

contents.name: Tenants
contents.description: Tenants hosted on this Tributech Node.
